items.title: Interactive Brokers Group (IBKR) Lets US Investors Trade Directly From Cashtags
items.summary: Interactive Brokers Group (NasdaqGS:IBKR) has integrated with X Cashtags, allowing US users to trade directly from tagged stock and crypto symbols. The rollout connects X discussions on financial topics to Interactive Brokers accounts, including account opening and order placement within the platform. The partnership targets US investors who engage with markets on social media and prefer fewer steps between research and execution. This new X Cashtags trading link is worth weighing alongside...
